title: Albemarle Q1 2026 results exhibit
excerpt: Q1 2026 adjusted EBITDA was USD 664 million; operating cash flow was USD 346 million and free cash flow USD 248 million, while debt-reduction actions paid down USD 1.3 billion.
summary: The SEC-hosted issuer exhibit supports current lithium price and volume recovery, commodity-scenario sensitivity, cash conversion, capex, liquidity, debt reduction, and mandatory-convertible dilution analysis for Albemarle.
